ref.substituent_description: 3,4-Difluorophenyl (F meta and para to the NH carbon) -NH-C(=O)-CH(hashed methyl)-O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2- bonded to the N of a 2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one (N-C(=O)-CH2-O fused to benzene).
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: 3 C=O plus 3 Kekule C=C in each benzene ring. NH written with H above N.

wrong.substituent_description: Left ring drawn with only five vertices and three inner double lines; NH on one vertex, F on the adjacent vertex (ortho) and F on the next (meta). Chain NH-C(=O)-CH(hashed methyl)-O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2-N into a benzoxazinone (N, C=O, CH2, O fused to Kekule benzene).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Left aryl ring has five vertices but three double bonds (impossible valence)
wrong.notes: Handwritten black pen. NH written H above N. Double bonds: 3 in left ring, 3 C=O, 3 in benzo ring.

correct.substituent_description: Benzene (circle) with NH at C1, F at C3 and C4 (meta and para). NH-C(=O)-CH(hashed methyl)-O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2- bonded to the N of a benzoxazinone (N-C(=O)-CH2-O fused to a circled benzene).
correct.notes: Handwritten black pen. NH written H above N. Three C=O; both benzene rings drawn with circles.

errors_in_wrong.description: The 3,4-difluorophenyl ring of the reference (six-membered) is drawn as a five-membered ring with three double bonds; one ring vertex is missing between the NH-bearing carbon and the F-bearing carbon, so as drawn the two F atoms sit ortho and meta to the NH carbon instead of meta and para.

review_notes: Wrong drawing's difluorophenyl ring has only five vertices; the F positions shift as a consequence. Corrected drawing has a six-membered ring with F meta/para and matches the reference (circle depiction instead of Kekule).
